entities.summary:
Scott Nearing was an American radical economist, educator, writer, political activist, pacifist, vegetarian and advocate of simple living. In 1915, he was dismissed from a teaching position at the Wharton School on account of his left-wing politics, becoming a cause célèbre of the American Left. His opposition to American entry into World War I led to his prosecution under the Espionage Act, for which he was found not guilty.

After the war, he became a leading leftist intellectual associated with the Socialist Party of America, and later with the Communist Party USA. Scott Nearing was a performers & entertainers from Tioga County (1883-08-06, Tioga County–1983-08-24). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
